retainedText: [Main Index] [On a Friday 1985-1991] [Pablo Honey] [The Bends] [OK Computer] [Kid A] [Amnesiac] [Hail to the Thief] [In Rainbows] [The King of Limbs] [A Moon Shaped Pool] [Thom Yorke] [Jonny Greenwood] [Ed O'Brien] [Colin Greenwood] [Philip Selway] UNTITLED ~ "Untitled" is the official name for the instrumental hidden track after "Motion Picture Soundtrack". It was sometimes referred to erroneously as "Genchildren" by fans, because of a pirate of the same name distributing the album "Kid A". Every track name from this pirate had 'Genchildren' appended to it (e.g. "Optimistic (Genchildren)"), and since the hidden track had no real title, the name of the track was rendered as simply "Genchildren".
